auth.aboutText1: MathForge is an AI-powered educational platform for university-level Linear Algebra and Calculus. It combines precise symbolic math (SymPy) with natural language explanations (Groq Llama-3), delivering 100% correct solutions with zero AI hallucinations.
auth.aboutText2: Built for students and teachers across Central Asia. Full support for English, Russian, and Kyrgyz.
auth.creatorBio: MathForge was designed and built by Dinaiym — a software developer passionate about making high-quality mathematics education accessible to students in Central Asia. The platform was created to bring AI-powered math tools to the classroom, in the languages students actually speak.

news.n1Desc: Annual inter-university mathematics olympiad covering Linear Algebra, Calculus, and Discrete Math. Open to all undergraduate students across Kyrgyzstan.
news.n2Desc: MathForge will be showcased at the KRSU Innovation Hackathon as a case study in neuro-symbolic AI for education.
news.n3Desc: Students can now track their daily study activity with a GitHub-style calendar heatmap and receive AI-generated practice for their weakest topics.
news.n4Desc: MathForge has partnered with the Kyrgyz-Russian Slavic University Mathematics Department to pilot the platform in first-year calculus courses.
